messages:
maria: Kicking off a 3-day rapid grooming batch — goal: decide what goes into the imminent patch vs what becomes a follow-on milestone. quick, concrete decisions only.
ajay: 👍 agree. we should prioritize regressions + customer blockers first.
sophia: can we lock UI polish out of the patch unless it's causing incorrect behavior?
dave: yes — infra/latency regressions are high priority. anything that trips error rates >1% or causes KV cache corruption = immediate.
leo: I've pulled a short list from support: 12 files — 4 crash/regression reports, 5 feature asks, 3 docs/confusion. I'll paste repro links in the doc.
maria: triage criteria proposal: 1) regression/crash 2) customer blocking 3) severity >= P1/P2 4) low-risk fix that reduces ops toil. Anything else?
ajay: add rollout risk: large surface changes that need model recompile go to milestone. small config/guardrail fixes can land in patch.
sophia: and UX regressions that change flows for existing customers => treat like regression.
product-bot: Reminder — three-day checklist created: Day1 triage, Day2 small fixes + canary, Day3 verify + freeze. See /docs/rapid-grooming (placeholder).
maria: Day1 plan (today): triage + owner assignment. Day2: engineering implements up to 4 low-risk fixes and deploys canary to 10% of traffic. Day3: validate metrics and sign-off or rollback.
ajay: owner assignments: I'll take crash-1 and latency-2. @sophia take the UX confusion item and I'll collaborate on the minor template change.
sophia: noted — will produce a 1-pager with before/after screenshots and acceptance criteria.
dave: I'll set a canary window and the rollback playbook. Metrics to watch: 5xx rate, p99 latency, KV-miss rate, error-budget burn.
leo: Customer comms: I'll draft a short note to affected customers for transparency.
maria: acceptance criteria for patch items: clear repro, tests or guardrail, <2% risk to deployment, and rollback plan. Anything not meeting those goes to milestone backlog.
ajay: quick grep command I used to find likely regressions: `git log --since=2weeks --grep="regress" && rg "exception|panic" src/` — saves time.
sophia: also flag any request that needs design exploration — those auto to milestone.
leo: support tip: tag customer threads with `patch-candidate` so we can filter quickly.
product-bot: Action created: #patch-candidates label applied to 6 threads.
maria: schedule check-ins: EOD day1 quick huddle 30m, day2 afternoon deploy check, day3 sign-off 11am.
ajay: estimate: 3 small fixes are doable in day2; 1 medium might spill to milestone.
dave: canary threshold: if p99 latency increases >15% or 5xx >0.5% we roll back.
sophia: are we keeping a docs-only patch? small copy fixes could ship with low risk.
maria: yes, docs-only and small copy/UI fixes that meet risk criteria can go in.
leo: putting owners in the ticket comments now.
maria: will compile a single confluence note after the day1 huddle with final list and owners. tagging @ajay @sophia @dave for visibility.
ajay: 👍 let's keep scope tight. anyone else with blockers?
sophia: none.
dave: nothing else.
leo: nope.
product-bot: Summary pinned to thread: 3-day rapid groom, triage criteria, owners assigned, canary plan + metrics, final sign-off time.
maria: thanks everyone — I'll run the day1 huddle at 16:00 PT. short agenda: 1) final triage list 2) owners 3) risk calls. See you then. :thumbsup:
